messages:
deploy-bot: Release v2.14.0 (canary->prod) PAUSED: env-parity-check failed for service `inference-worker`. Blocker: keystore/kvs key normalization mismatch. See `/deploy/checks/2305000123` :warning:

deploy-bot: Check output snippet:
```
- staging secret: INFERENCE_KEY (base64)
- prod secret: inference_key (base64)
- staging keystore path: /keystore/inference/primary
- prod keystore path: /Keystore/inference/primary
- result: key-case-normalization: FAIL
```

marta: ugh, casing again. we normalize to lower-case in the staging deploy script but prod relies on original case. who touched the keystore import step?

kevin: i updated the import last week when onboarding the new s3 exporter. my change lowercased keys to avoid weird duplicates. i assumed all consumers were case-insensitive.

ops-jen: prod k8s secret names are case-preserving and our vault sync retains case. lowercasing in staging was a convenience for local dev, but not safe for prod.

ryan: is rollback safe? current canary has ~5% traffic; it's blocked from promotion. If we rollback the canary to v2.13, we need to ensure model-variant pin is preserved.

samir: quick mitigation: patch the staging import to preserve case and re-run preflight, or add a deploy-time transform to canonicalize both sides to a normalized key path. Prefer we fix staging script and re-run checks.

marta: agree. but we should also add a one-off fix for prod to accept both variants until next maintenance window. ops-jen can we add a short-lived alias?

ops-jen: we can add an alias key `INFERENCE_KEY` pointing to existing `inference_key` in prod keystore, but that requires KMS write and audit. Need approval and a 10-min maintenance window.

kevin: i can prepare the patch for the staging import and a changelog entry. Also will add a test to the deploybot preflight to catch any key-name canonicalization differences.

ryan: for transparency, let's capture rollback decision tree: 
- option A: fix staging import, re-run preflight, promote (preferred)
- option B: add prod alias + minor patch, then promote (shorter time but more prod change)
- option C: rollback canary to v2.13 and run incident postmortem (slower customer impact)

marta: I vote A if we can get the staging patch through in ~20m. If not, B as fallback. No rollback unless both fail.

deploy-bot: noted. Release paused. Next required action: `marta` to push staging fix or `ops-jen` to schedule prod alias. Deadline 2305000400 or automatic rollback will be considered.

kevin: pushing staging-import revert now. patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/compare/keystore-preserve-case (WIP)

ops-jen: i'll stand by for alias window. if kevin's PR lands and preflight passes, cancel the alias plan.

samir: don't forget to update release notes: call out keystore key-name parity fix and that we added a preflight to detect key normalization diffs.

marta: will update release notes and changelog. thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Preflight re-run scheduled at 2305000450. Will post results in thread.
